mission: caller issues exactly one observe request and reads bounded typed frames, then qualifies S27 source-native projection

transport.nonprobe_frames: contiguous MineflayerObservation allowed until bounded explicit probe

negative_gates: wrong Action, WorldConsequence, adapter_started session, or parent sequence
absent target, no probe, too many interleaved nonprobe frames
send error or timeout consume one-shot cursor without retry or proposal
limitations: Existing bridge observe command and observation response have no request_id; serialized caller lease and message ordering cannot cryptographically or causally distinguish an unsolicited queued probe
Source is typed deterministic adapter double, not a running Mineflayer process or live Minecraft endpoint
Exclusive access is a caller-side assumption; no global interprocess transport lock or exactly-once guarantee
Sequence cursor is a caller-owned in-memory token; no persistence, restart proof or global replay ledger
Caller supplies observed_at_ns and inspected_at_ns; adapter frames themselves have no authenticated wall-clock timestamps
S27 coverage and target identity limits remain: target missing never implies safety
No new Action/Skill owner, sensor listener, scheduler, automatic epoch, World actuation, learning or Paper2 MAIN40 reinterpretation
